title: Snow Coats: redrawn by hand
kaylee: The fox, the hare, the ptarmigan, the lemming, the bear and the owl are redrawn and look at her, on a hand-drawn tundra where the snow settles on the same hills and bushes.

pictures.title: Paint the fox
pictures.caption: The generated tundra is gone: sky, mountains, hills, bushes and stones are drawn in code

pictures.title: Hide and seek
pictures.caption: Bushes and stones get snow caps; the white coats keep a soft shade

pictures.title: Rub the summer back
pictures.caption: A new sun, and the owl on a drawn rock
